[[F.C. Motagua|C.D. Motagua]] and [[C.D. Marathón]] each lifted one trophy obtaining the 39th and 40th national championship respectively in the history of the league.[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesh/hond02.html RSSSF.com–Honduras 2001/02]–11 December 2009 This was the fourth season under the [[Apertura and Clausura]] format. ==2001–02 teams== {{colbegin}} * [[Deportes Savio]] ([[Santa Rosa de Copán]]) * [[C.D.
